headline: Bitcoin Options Position Shifts Bearish as $7 Billion Expiry Approaches
summary: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of a $7 billion expiry on Friday, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.
why: Bitcoin options expirations are key market events that can trigger heightened price volatility and liquidity shifts across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The options expiry directly impacts Bitcoin derivatives pricing and market volatility.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Traders piling into downside protection ahead of a major options expiry increase short-term bearish pressure and volatility.
